Vale Rovers — onboarding notes
Author: Sam Okafor · Last edited 14 February 2026
Shared drive › Clients › Vale Rovers

Vale Rovers ("Rovers", "VRFC" in their own systems) signed in January 2026 and went live on the platform on 10 February 2026. They are our third client club, after Kingsport FC and Harbour Athletic.

What they use
- Club Console: memberships, season tickets and renewals. Their staff log in through the club's own identity provider.
- Fan App: supporters buy and renew season tickets here. White-labelled as "Rovers Live".
- Payments run through PayRail on our platform account. Payouts to the club are weekly.

Size
- About 4,200 season ticket holders. Ground: Vale Park, capacity 9,800.
- Renewal window: 1 November to 15 December each year.

Contacts
- Tom Ellis, Head of Ticketing. Day-to-day contact for anything ticketing or renewals. Prefers a weekly call during the renewal window.
- Mira Chen, Finance lead. Payouts and refunds only.

Things to know
- Many older supporters renew by phone, with a club staff member entering the card. Card failures are more common for these.
- The club has asked for a longer grace period than the platform default. Agreed in principle; see the grace period setting.
- They do not want supporters' seats released without a phone call first.
